entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit customer support. My name is Charlie. How can I assist you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand Pulse monitor. It's not for me. I need a return label.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
There's no 'fault', I just don't like it! It's uncomfortable. I want to send it back and get my money. It's that simple.
Okay, I understand. I'll just need your order number to pull up your account details.
Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see your order. The VeloBand Pulse was delivered on December 20th, which was 25 days ago.
And? So what? Just send me the label.
Sir, I'm afraid it's too late to process a return for this item. Our return policy for the VeloBand Pulse is 10 days from the date of delivery.
WHAT?! Are you kidding me? TEN DAYS? That's insane! I thought you had a 90-day policy! This is absolute garbage.

I understand the confusion, sir, but our 90-day policy applies to apparel and other equipment. For wearable electronics that have direct skin contact, like the VeloBand Pulse, the policy is much stricter for health and hygiene reasons.
Hygiene? I barely even wore it! This is a scam! I want to speak to a manager. Now. Put one on the phone.

Sir, I am the highest point of contact for this issue, as a manager would have to tell you the same information. This policy is firm for all customers. After 20 days, we cannot make any exceptions at all due to sanitation protocols and the bio-contaminant risk.

Bio-contaminant risk? Are you listening to yourself? This is the worst customer service I've ever dealt with! Fine. If you won't help me, I'll just tell everyone online how VeloFit rips off its customers with its fake policies. I'm going to leave a review on every single website I can find.

I am sorry you feel that way, but the policy is in place to ensure the safety of our products and customers. While a return for a refund isn't possible, some customers have had success using the official VeloFit Resale Marketplace to sell their devices to other users.
Oh, so now you want me to do your job and sell it myself? Unbelievable. You've been zero help. You've just lost a customer for good.
I understand your frustration. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
